english.title: Fishing vessel owner fail to allow fisherman to see a copy of their fisherman's work agreement
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the owner of a fishing vessel, namely **(..SPECIFY VESSEL..), failed to allow a fisherman on the vessel, namely **(..SPECIFY FISHERMAN..), to see

(A)_[the copy of the fisherman's work agreement to which he was a party]_
(B)_[the copy of the fisherman's work agreement to which she was a party]_
(C)_[a copy of a document referred to in the fisherman's work agreement to which he was a party, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT..),]_
(D)_[a copy of a document referred to in the fisherman's work agreement to which she was a party, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT..),]_
(E)_the translation of a document required by regulation 11 of the Merchant Shipping (Work in Fishing Convention) Regulations 2018, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT..),]_

on request
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 10(3)(b) and (4) and 29(2) of the Merchant Shipping (Work in Fishing Convention) Regulations 2018.
